knowledge.heroBody: A personalised library of the errors that keep showing up in your lessons. Each entry explains why Polish speakers make the error, what the English rule actually is, and how to fix it. Fossilised errors — the ones that have recurred 3+ times — get a red badge so you know where to focus.
